about_the_game:
Rise Up Dead Man Anniversary Collection

Seven versions of Rise Up Dead Man collected to celebrate seven years of Hunt. From the original Hunt “Humming Theme” battle anthem to a never-before-heard slowed down “Bones and Bounties” version. Let the gunshots ring! Includes both .wav and .mp3 audio files.

content_descriptors.notes: It does not include any violent content, as it's an official album of Hunt: Showdown 1896.
